description: Add form.published and form.closed webhook events with a per-webhook events subscription. Independent of FEAT-002 (different code paths; both touch webhookDelivery.ts and its test file, so run FEAT-001 first). Adds a text[] `events` column to Webhook (default [response.created]) via a hand-authored raw-SQL migration, a form-level payload builder, a pure event-filter predicate, the two new emit paths (publishForm, closeForm, closeDueForms), API schema/service/route threading, the editor UI, and unit tests. Back-compatible: existing webhooks keep receiving only response.created. Preserve answersLabeled/optionLabels and the signing path.
steps: Prisma schema + migration: add `events String[] @default(["response.created"])` to the Webhook model in prisma/schema.prisma. Create prisma/migrations/20261001000000_add_webhook_events/migration.sql (timestamp strictly AFTER the latest existing 20260930000000_add_payments) with hand-authored raw SQL: `ALTER TABLE "Webhook" ADD COLUMN "events" TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY['response.created']::TEXT[];` then a backfill `UPDATE "Webhook" SET "events" = ARRAY['response.created']::TEXT[] WHERE "events" = '{}';`. Match the quoted-identifier Postgres style of 20260929000000_add_webhooks/migration.sql. Then from repo root run `pnpm exec prisma generate`.

In apps/api/src/services/webhookDelivery.ts add: an exported readonly tuple `WEBHOOK_EVENTS = ["response.created","form.published","form.closed"] as const` and `type WebhookEvent`; a `FormEventPayload` type `{ event; formId; formTitle; slug; status; at }`; pure `buildFormEventPayload(event: WebhookEvent, form: { id; title; slug; status }): FormEventPayload` returning `{ event, formId: form.id, formTitle: form.title, slug: form.slug, status: form.status, at: new Date().toISOString() }`; and pure `webhookAcceptsEvent(events: string[] | null | undefined, event: string): boolean` = `Array.isArray(events) && events.includes(event)`. Keep EVENT_RESPONSE_CREATED.

In apps/api/src/services/webhookDelivery.ts: in sendWebhooksForResponse, filter the loaded webhooks with webhookAcceptsEvent(w.events, payload.event) before creating delivery rows. Add exported async sendFormEventWebhooks(form: { id; title; slug; status }, event: WebhookEvent): loads enabled webhooks for form.id, filters by webhookAcceptsEvent(w.events, event), bounds by MAX_WEBHOOKS_PER_FORM, creates a pending WebhookDelivery with event + buildFormEventPayload payload, runs attemptDelivery per row via Promise.allSettled, wrapped in try/catch so it never throws (mirror sendWebhooksForResponse exactly). Do NOT change attemptDelivery/deliverDueWebhooks event handling (delivery.event already flows into X-Qivo-Event).

In apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts: add sendFormEventWebhooks to the existing import from ../../services/webhookDelivery.js. In publishForm, after the $transaction commits (updatedForm is PUBLISHED and the version snapshot is written), add a fire-and-forget block mirroring the existing webhook/notification blocks: `void (async () => { await sendFormEventWebhooks({ id: updatedForm.id, title: updatedForm.title, slug: updatedForm.slug, status: updatedForm.status }, "form.published"); })().catch((err) => console.error("form.published webhook trigger failed:", err));`. Leave `return updatedForm;` unchanged.

In apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts: in closeForm, after prisma.form.update(... status: "CLOSED"), add a fire-and-forget sendFormEventWebhooks({ id: updatedForm.id, title: updatedForm.title, slug: updatedForm.slug, status: updatedForm.status }, "form.closed") block (never throws). In closeDueForms, after the updateMany, re-select the closed forms `{ id, title, slug, status }` with `where: { id: { in: dueIds } }` and fire sendFormEventWebhooks(..., "form.closed") for each inside one fire-and-forget try/catch so a webhook failure never breaks the sweep; keep `return result.count;` unchanged.

Thread events through the API CRUD. In apps/api/src/modules/webhooks/webhook.schemas.ts import WEBHOOK_EVENTS from ../../services/webhookDelivery.js and add `events: z.array(z.enum(WEBHOOK_EVENTS)).min(1).optional()` to createWebhookSchema and updateWebhookSchema (keep updateWebhookSchema.enabled as-is; add events optional). In apps/api/src/modules/webhooks/webhook.service.ts add events to WebhookDto + toWebhookDto, accept events?: string[] in createWebhook (default ["response.created"] when omitted) and persist it, accept optional events in updateWebhook. In apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.routes.ts POST and PATCH handlers pass `...(input.events !== undefined ? { events: input.events } : {})` (conditional-spread per exactOptionalPropertyTypes).

Add API tests. Extend apps/api/src/services/webhookDelivery.test.ts with describes for buildFormEventPayload (asserts the pinned {event,formId,formTitle,slug,status,at} shape; at is a parseable ISO string) and webhookAcceptsEvent (false for ["response.created"]+form.published; true for ["form.published"]+form.published; false for null/empty). Add apps/api/src/modules/webhooks/webhook.schemas.test.ts asserting createWebhookSchema rejects an unknown event name and accepts a valid events array.

Update the web UI. In apps/web/src/types/index.ts add `events: string[]` to the Webhook type. In apps/web/src/components/WebhooksTabPanel.tsx add an events checkbox group to the add-webhook form ("New response"=response.created checked by default, "Form published"=form.published, "Form closed"=form.closed), include events in the POST body (default ["response.created"] when none chosen), and render each webhook's subscribed events in its WebhookRow using the same friendly labels. Keep the existing editor CSS classes and inline-style patterns.
acceptance_criteria: From repo root, `pnpm exec prisma validate` and `pnpm exec prisma generate` exit 0; prisma/migrations/20261001000000_add_webhook_events/migration.sql exists with the ADD COLUMN default + backfill; schema.prisma shows events on Webhook; apps/api/src/generated/prisma reflects it.
`cd apps/api && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit` exits 0.

`cd apps/api && pnpm test` is green including the new buildFormEventPayload, webhookAcceptsEvent, and schema-rejection tests; a webhook with events ["response.created"] is not selected for form.published and one with ["form.published"] is.
`cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit` exits 0, `pnpm test` green, `pnpm build` OK; the editor lets a user pick events and shows each webhook's subscribed events.
Existing webhooks (default events) still receive only response.created; no existing payload field or header renamed/removed; signing path unchanged.

cd apps/api ; pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit ; pnpm test
cd apps/web ; pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit ; pnpm test ; pnpm build
findings: DONE. Event names (exact): "response.created", "form.published", "form.closed". Migration folder: prisma/migrations/20261001000000_add_webhook_events (ADD COLUMN events TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY['response.created']::TEXT[] + empty-array backfill). Schema: Webhook.events String[] @default(["response.created"]); Prisma client regenerated at apps/api/src/generated/prisma. New exported symbols in apps/api/src/services/webhookDelivery.ts: WEBHOOK_EVENTS (readonly tuple), type WebhookEvent, type FormEventPayload, buildFormEventPayload(event, {id,title,slug,status}) -> {event,formId,formTitle,slug,status,at(ISO)}, webhookAcceptsEvent(events,event), sendFormEventWebhooks(form,event). sendWebhooksForResponse now filters loaded webhooks by webhookAcceptsEvent(w.events, payload.event). Emit paths wired in apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts: publishForm -> form.published (after $transaction), closeForm -> form.closed, closeDueForms -> re-selects {id,title,slug,status} for dueIds and fires form.closed per form in one fire-and-forget Promise.allSettled. API CRUD threaded: webhook.schemas.ts createWebhookSchema+updateWebhookSchema gained events: z.array(z.enum(WEBHOOK_EVENTS)).min(1).optional(); webhook.service.ts WebhookDto/toWebhookDto gained events: string[], createWebhook defaults ["response.created"] when omitted, updateWebhook conditional-spreads events; form.routes.ts POST+PATCH conditional-spread events. attemptDelivery/deliverDueWebhooks unchanged (delivery.event still flows to X-Qivo-Event). answersLabeled/optionLabels and signing path untouched. Web: Webhook type gained events: string[]; WebhooksTabPanel.tsx adds an Events checkbox group (New response/Form published/Form closed, response.created checked by default), sends events in POST (defaults ["response.created"]), and renders each row's subscribed events via friendly labels. Tests added: webhookDelivery.test.ts (buildFormEventPayload shape+ISO, webhookAcceptsEvent true/false/null/empty) and new webhook.schemas.test.ts (rejects unknown event, accepts valid array, optional, rejects empty). Verification all green: prisma validate/generate exit 0; apps/api tsc 0, pnpm test 176 passed (10 files); apps/web tsc -b 0, pnpm test 81 passed, pnpm build OK. NOTE for FEAT-002: it also touches webhookDelivery.ts + its test file; FEAT-001 did not modify attemptDelivery's fetch (still uses global fetch, not node:https pinning) — that SSRF-pinning work belongs to FEAT-002.
